canonical_state_owner: PostgreSQL, with pgvector for semantic retrieval and content-addressed byte references for immutable artifacts
durable_execution_backend: Hatchet behind DurableExecutionPort; Temporal and DBOS are qualified fallbacks
operator_stack: React and TypeScript web client with Tauri official plugins for Windows packaging and WinSW for eligible Windows-native services
selection_rules: The latest authoritative source chronology controls target selection unless an explicit later ADR changes it.
A selected target is not live-qualified until its activation gate has current evidence.
Vendor SDK types and vendor workflow history cannot become authoritative Project Pipeline domain state.
Unknown or conflicting license/release evidence blocks activation without erasing the source-selected architecture intent.
Optional and fallback technologies remain behind internal ports and require compatibility and rollback evidence.
